submission: Submitting final implementation of house.js. House.verse(n) builds the stanza from a PIECES table: line 1 is "This is the <subject[n-1]>", then for i=n-1..1 "that <verb[i]> the <subject[i-1]>"; House.verses(start,end) concatenates stanzas with a blank separator line and yields [] when end < start.
